lines.en: I call Sara and wind up getting talked into meeting her at some cafe that I really don't want to go to. But I guess it's fine since there isn't anywhere else I'd want to be either.
lines.zh: 我打给 Sara，结果被她说动，去了某家我根本不想去的咖啡厅。不过也无所谓，反正我也没有别的地方想去。

lines.en: Beggars can't be choosers, after all. And if I'm going to funnel my misery down the throats of unsuspecting friends, I should at least let them choose where to open up their mouths.
lines.zh: 毕竟讨饭的没资格挑三拣四。既然要把自己的痛苦灌进毫不知情的朋友喉咙里，我总该让他们自己挑张嘴的地方。

lines.en: As such, Sara's mouth (As well as the rest of her) keeps me company within the confines of a building that smells like bread. So much so that I have a headache within minutes.
lines.zh: 于是，在一栋闻起来全是面包味的房子里，Sara 的嘴（以及她的其他部分）陪着我。味道重到没几分钟我就开始头疼。

lines.en: To avoid the pain, I retreat to the bathroom and make myself throw up. This only makes the pain worse. But when I come back into the lobby, things go back to normal.
lines.zh: 为了躲开这疼痛，我躲进洗手间把自己抠吐了。这反而让头疼更厉害。可等我回到大堂，一切又恢复了正常。

lines.en: My mask is secured tight enough so as to not alert Sara that I'm anything less than perfect right now.
lines.zh: 我的面具戴得够紧，不至于让 Sara 察觉我现在有半点不完美。

lines.en: Either that, or there's no amount of convincing that could get her to change her mind about me in the first place.
lines.zh: 要么就是，根本没有什么说辞能改变她对我的看法。

lines.en: Her feet keep bumping into mine beneath the table. I think she's trying to tell me something.
lines.zh: 桌子底下，她的脚不停地碰我的脚。我觉得她想告诉我什么。

lines.en: But I already know what that something is, and it's something I don't want to hear. So I kick her back in a way that's meant to tell her I'd rather be left alone.
lines.zh: 可我已经知道那是什么了，而且那是我不想听的东西。于是我回踢了她一下，想表示我宁愿一个人待着。

lines.en: She kicks me again. And again. And again. Until my feet are swollen and no longer fit in my shoes.
lines.zh: 她又踢我。再踢。再踢。直到我的脚肿得连鞋都穿不进去。

lines.en: I might have made that part up. But it changes nothing.
lines.zh: 那部分可能是我编的。但什么都没改变。

lines.en: I still want to chop them off.
lines.zh: 我还是想把它们给剁掉。
